messages.text: Sharma ji! Surely a massive investment bank needs a 30% or 50% market crash to go under? And private OTC derivative contracts only affect the two parties signing them, right?
Not at all, Raju! At Lehman Brothers' 31:1 leverage ratio in 2007, capital equity was just 1 / 31 ≈ 3.23%. A tiny 3% to 4% asset decline wiped out 100% of their equity capital!
Combined with Dick Fuld removing the risk officer and 1 million OTC trades across 8,000 counterparties, Lehman collapsed on September 15, 2008.

beats.en_subtitle: Futures trade publicly with standardized terms; forwards trade privately with custom terms.

leftColumn.title: Exchange-Traded Futures
leftColumn.subtitle: Public Organized Exchanges (CME, ICE)
bullets: Strictly standardized contract sizes, delivery locations, and months
Traded publicly on transparent, organized exchange order books
High liquidity enabling easy close-outs prior to maturity

rightColumn.title: OTC Forward Contracts
rightColumn.subtitle: Decentralized Interbank Network
bullets: Fully customized terms negotiated bilaterally between counterparties
Traded privately via telephone and electronic networks without a floor
Usually held to maturity or requiring bilateral consent to unwind

beats.hindi_tts: फ्यूचर्स में क्लीयरिंग हाउस हर दिन मार्क-टू-मार्केट सेटलमेंट और मार्जिन के जरिए काउंटरपार्टी क्रेडिट रिस्क को पूरी तरह खत्म कर देता है, जबकि फॉरवर्ड्स में सेटलमेंट केवल मेच्योरिटी पर होता है।
beats.en_subtitle: Futures use daily clearing house settlement to remove credit risk; forwards settle at maturity.

leftColumn.title: Clearing House Settlement
leftColumn.subtitle: Daily Mark-to-Market Margining
bullets: Clearing house interposes itself as central counterparty to all trades
Initial and variation margins eliminate bilateral counterparty default risk
Daily cash flows settle unrealized gains and losses continuously

rightColumn.title: Maturity Settlement
rightColumn.subtitle: Traditional OTC Bilateral Risk
bullets: Traditional forwards settle once at contract maturity
Exposes trading parties to direct counterparty credit default risk
Post-2008 reforms mandate CCP clearing and bilateral CSAs to curb risk

beats.hindi_tts: फ्यूचर्स व्यापारी मेच्योरिटी से पहले ही विपरीत ट्रेड डालकर अपनी पोजीशन आसानी से बंद कर लेते हैं, जबकि ओटीसी फॉरवर्ड्स में मेच्योरिटी तक बने रहना पड़ता है या दोनों पक्षों की रजामंदी चाहिए।
beats.en_subtitle: Futures are easily closed out via offsetting trades before maturity; forwards require consent.

leftColumn.title: Offsetting Close-Outs
leftColumn.subtitle: Futures Liquidity Mechanism
bullets: The vast majority of futures positions are closed out before maturity
Traders simply enter an equal and opposite offsetting trade on exchange
Physical delivery is rare compared to cash settlement or offsetting

rightColumn.title: Bilateral Lock-In
rightColumn.subtitle: Forward Agreement Constraints
bullets: Forwards lack public order books for instant offsetting
Unwinding a forward prior to maturity requires explicit bilateral consent
Creates liquidity and credit lock-in for institutional market participants

scenes.title: Active Recall: FX Forward & Leverage Math

beats.hindi_tts: अब आपकी बारी: 13 मई 2015 को 3 महीने के फॉरवर्ड कोट्स 1.5736 बिड और 1.5742 ऑफर थे। इम्पोर्ट-को 10 मिलियन पाउंड चुकाती है। साथ ही बैंक 31:1 लेवरेज पर है। सही उत्तर चुनिए।
beats.en_subtitle: ImportCo hedges £10M payable at 1.5736/1.5742 forwards; bank runs at 31:1 leverage. Find the values.

ui_state.question: On May 13, 2015, 3-month USD/GBP forwards are quoted at 1.5736 Bid / 1.5742 Offer. ImportCo hedges a £10 million payable using 3-month forwards. Simultaneously, an investment bank operates at a 31:1 leverage ratio. What USD payment does ImportCo lock in, and what asset decline percentage wipes out 100% of the bank's equity?

beats.hindi_tts: सोचिए: इम्पोर्टर हायर ऑफर रेट पर खरीदता है, और 31:1 लेवरेज पर इक्विटी 1 बटा 31 यानी 3.23 परसेंट होती है।
beats.en_subtitle: Think: importers buy at the offer rate, and 31:1 leverage gives a 3.23% equity buffer.

ui_state.question: On May 13, 2015, 3-month USD/GBP forwards are quoted at 1.5736 Bid / 1.5742 Offer. ImportCo hedges a £10 million payable using 3-month forwards. Simultaneously, an investment bank operates at a 31:1 leverage ratio. What USD payment does ImportCo lock in, and what asset decline percentage wipes out 100% of the bank's equity?

beats.hindi_tts: बिल्कुल सही! इम्पोर्ट-को 1.5742 के ऑफर रेट पर 15,742,000 डॉलर लॉक करती है, और 31:1 लेवरेज पर 3.23 परसेंट इक्विटी होने के कारण सिर्फ 3 से 4 परसेंट एसेट गिरने पर पूंजी पूरी तरह साफ हो जाती है।
beats.en_subtitle: ImportCo locks in $15,742,000 at the offer rate; 31:1 leverage wipes out equity on a 3%-4% drop.

ui_state.question: On May 13, 2015, 3-month USD/GBP forwards are quoted at 1.5736 Bid / 1.5742 Offer. ImportCo hedges a £10 million payable using 3-month forwards. Simultaneously, an investment bank operates at a 31:1 leverage ratio. What USD payment does ImportCo lock in, and what asset decline percentage wipes out 100% of the bank's equity?
ui_state.answer: ImportCo locks in $15,742,000 at the 1.5742 offer rate; at 31:1 leverage, equity is 3.23% (1/31), so a 3% to 4% asset decline wipes out capital equity.

beats.hindi_tts: राजू अपना पहला नियम पक्का करता है: फॉरेक्स फॉरवर्ड्स में इम्पोर्टर हमेशा ऑफर रेट पर खरीदता है (£10M पर 1.5742 यानी 15,742,000 डॉलर), और एक्सपोर्टर बिड रेट पर बेचता है।
beats.en_subtitle: Raju confirms Rule 1: Importers buy forward at Offer ($15.742M for £10M); exporters sell at Bid.

messages.text: Checklist Rule 1 (Bid/Offer Precision): When hedging FX forwards, importers buying foreign currency pay the higher Offer rate (£10M x $1.5742 = $15,742,000), while exporters selling receive the Bid rate!

beats.hindi_tts: राजू दूसरा नियम जोड़ता है: लेवरेज का सम्मान करो। 31:1 लेवरेज यानी 3.23 परसेंट इक्विटी पर जरा सा भी एसेट ड्रॉप और शॉर्ट टर्म डेट फ्रीज बैंक को सीधे दिवालिया बना देता है।
beats.en_subtitle: Raju confirms Rule 2: Respect leverage—31:1 leverage (3.23% equity) collapses during funding freezes.

messages.text: Checklist Rule 1 (Bid/Offer Precision): When hedging FX forwards, importers buying foreign currency pay the higher Offer rate (£10M x $1.5742 = $15,742,000), while exporters selling receive the Bid rate!
Rule 2 (Leverage Safety): Never ignore balance-sheet leverage. At 31:1 leverage (3.23% equity), a 3% to 4% asset dip combined with frozen short-term debt triggers total insolvency.

beats.hindi_tts: शर्मा जी तीसरा और अंतिम नियम जोड़ते हैं: सीसीपी क्लियरिंग, ट्रेड रिपॉजिटरी और सीएसए मार्जिन का उपयोग करें ताकि काउंटरपार्टी डिफॉल्ट से कभी सिस्टमिक डोमिनो चेन न बने।
beats.en_subtitle: Sharma ji seals Rule 3: use CCP clearing, trade repositories, and CSAs to prevent systemic contagion.

stageDirections: — Sharma ji seals the systemic risk rule —

messages.text: Checklist Rule 1 (Bid/Offer Precision): When hedging FX forwards, importers buying foreign currency pay the higher Offer rate (£10M x $1.5742 = $15,742,000), while exporters selling receive the Bid rate!
Rule 2 (Leverage Safety): Never ignore balance-sheet leverage. At 31:1 leverage (3.23% equity), a 3% to 4% asset dip combined with frozen short-term debt triggers total insolvency.
And Rule 3 (Clearing & Collateral Protection): Always use CCP clearing, trade repositories, and bilateral CSAs so counterparty defaults never trigger a systemic domino collapse!

beats.en_subtitle: Let us weave together the eight core principles of today's chapter.

ui_state.heading: Today's thread
steps: Derivatives derive value from underlying assets; locking in a September corn price protects both farmer and miller, standardized as a 5,000-bushel ($20,000) CME Corn contract
Futures trade on public exchanges with standardized terms and daily clearing house margins; traditional forwards are customized bilateral contracts settled at maturity
The OTC market reaches $630 trillion in notional principal ($21 trillion gross market value), dwarfing the $65 trillion in exchange-traded underlying assets
At maturity, a long forward or futures position yields Payoff = S_T - K, while a short position yields Payoff = K - S_T
Using 3-month USD/GBP forwards (1.5736 Bid / 1.5742 Offer), ImportCo buys £10M at 1.5742 ($15,742,000 cost) and ExportCo sells £30M at 1.5736 ($47,208,000 revenue)
Equity capital percentage equals 1 / Leverage Ratio; at Lehman Brothers' 31:1 leverage in 2007, equity was just 3.23%, so a 3% to 4% asset drop wiped out 100% of equity

Lehman Brothers filed the largest bankruptcy on Sept 15, 2008, driven by 31:1 leverage, aggressive risk culture (removing the CRO in 2007), unhedged subprime assets, and 1M+ OTC trades across 8,000 counterparties
To stop Bank A's default from toppling Bank B and Bank C, regulators mandated SEFs, CCPs, Trade Repositories, and bilateral CSAs with segregated initial margin
ui_state.bottomTakeaway: Futures and OTC forwards provide essential price-fixing tools across a $630+ trillion market, but surviving leverage and preventing systemic domino collapses require daily mark-to-market clearing, segregated collateral, and strict risk oversight.
